title.narrative: UNICEF contributed positively to;children’s well-being:;the stunting rate decreased from 16% in 2016 to 14.4% in 2024, while overweight and obesity dropped from 10.1% to 8.6% during the same period. Additionally, the rate of exclusive breastfeeding saw a significant increase, rising from 58.7% in 2016 to 70% in 2024.
